claim: Disrobe detects 190 of 190 labeled command-injection flows in the NIST SARD Juliet v1.3 char/system C corpus with gcc 16.2.0 -O2, with zero false positives.
detail: 190 of 190 labeled command-injection flows recalled across the 8 populated categories, precision 100% (190 of 190 flagged findings land on a corpus-labeled bad chain, 0 false positives against any of the 190 good-labeled counterparts). The good-labeled counterparts call no source, so this precision figure cannot catch an over-reaching pointer model; compiled_pointer_constructs_flag_only_the_twin_whose_sink_reads_the_tainted_buffer is the precision control for that, with a flowing and a severed twin per pointer construct at -O2 and -O0. The other 7 declared categories (container, callback, virtual call, string operation, sanitiser-severs, recursion, library boundary) hold 0 cases in this corpus slice.
gate_source: crates/disrobe-taint/tests/graded_corpus.rs, assert_fresh_grade_clears_named_floors, sum over the 8 populated categories; ground truth is manifest.xml and each file's own Flow Variant header

oracle.external: NIST SARD Juliet Test Suite for C/C++ v1.3 (2017-10-01), CWE-78 char/system C files. The grader reads manifest.xml flaw locations and Flow Variant headers. Each group contributes one verdict for its bad-labeled call chain and one for its good-labeled chain.
oracle.note: These figures cover native input compiled from C. Seven of the 15 declared flow categories have no cases in this slice: container, callback, virtual call, string operation, sanitiser, recursion, and library boundary. With gcc 16.2.0 -O0, detection is also 190 of 190 flows with zero false positives, including the 15 flows that cross more than one call. The separate published_juliet_o2_bars_match_the_pinned_floors test checks the published counts without compiling the corpus.

reproduce: cargo test -p disrobe-taint --test graded_corpus juliet_cwe78_command_injection_precision_recall_o2 -- --exact --nocapture, with the pinned Juliet corpus cache populated. CI does not provision it, so tests/optional.toml lists the binary and a run without it writes a not-measured record instead of passing.
title: Native taint analysis on Juliet CWE-78
